assumptions: 3/10/30s command hold reflects user circuit-running scenario.
40C ambient, Rds=.017ohm*2 temperature factor are engineering assumptions, not measured limits.
52/137C/W are fixture-specific data sheet numbers; neither is this PCB verified RthetaJA.
1/10/100s thermal time constants and .1/1/5s motor current decay are sensitivity inputs, not manufacturer/motor measured values.
Holding brake does not itself apply battery drive: motor back EMF drives the short-brake loop and normally decays after stopping.
Sustained current represents externally sustained rotation/generation; it is not inferred from a 30s brake command.
No coupled heating from Q1/driver/boost/battery, no airflow/enclosure measurements.
Results exceeding150C indicate a failed assumed thermal scenario, not a predicted real temperature beyond ratings.
